extraction: Raw VizieR asu-tsv response saved verbatim. Rows counted after skipping '#' comment lines, the header line, the units line and the '---' separator line; blank trailing lines excluded.
note: Balestra et al. 2016 ApJS 224, 33, Table 2: the CLASH-VLT VIMOS SPECTROSCOPIC redshift catalogue of MACS J0416.1-2403 (4386 objects over ~25x25 arcmin, far wider than the HST/HFF footprint). MEASURED: RA/Dec (J2000), spectroscopic redshift z, quality flag q_z (2,3,4,9 = insecure..secure), reference code r_z, Subaru/Suprime-Cam Kron R-band AB magnitude. NO membership column: Balestra+2016 define members by |z - z_cl|; apply a redshift cut around z_cl = 0.396. Single band only, so no colour. No stellar mass, no Sersic parameters.
